name: UniFi Controller
tagline: Manage UniFi network gear from the browser
description: Self-hosted UniFi Network Application: manage UniFi APs, switches and gateways without a Cloud Key. Devices adopt over L2 discovery.
compose:
services:
  unifi:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/unifi-controller:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8443"
      - "3478:3478/udp"
      - "10001:10001/udp"
      - "8080:8080/tcp"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
